A check that compares two sources against each other.

sections.name: File setup, format, sourceLabel, statusLabel
sections.title: Imports and number and label helpers
sections.what: Brings in the components and translation helpers the panel needs. Defines small helpers that format numbers, label each area source and label each comparison status.
sections.why: Keeps number formatting and status wording in one place so the cards and summaries agree.
sections.watch_out: The status helper must cover every status value the API can send, or a status will show the fallback label.

sections.name: AreaSourceCard
sections.title: Area source card
sections.what: Shows one area source with its label, its acreage with four decimal places, and a link to the source document unless the area was calculated from the geometry. Adds a details block for traceability.
sections.why: Lets the owner see each area number and go to the original document behind it.
sections.watch_out: When the acreage is missing, the card shows an unavailable label instead of a number.

sections.name: ParcelIntelligencePanel
sections.title: Main parcel intelligence view
sections.what: Loads the parcel data, then shows the map, safety note, identity table, calculated areas in square metres, hectares and acres, a card for each area source, a summary, the official record context and earth observation teaser, a list of pairwise comparisons with their results, and a method section with the disclaimer.
sections.why: Puts the full area evidence in one place so the owner can compare the sources and read the method.
sections.watch_out: The pairwise list looks up each source with a forced match, so a missing source would cause an error on that screen.

sections.name: ParcelIntelligenceTeaser
sections.title: Compact parcel intelligence teaser
sections.what: Loads the parcel data and shows a short card that says whether sources are available and whether a mapped boundary exists, with a link to the full view.
sections.why: Gives a quick status on other pages without loading the whole view.
sections.watch_out: The request does not cancel when the card leaves the screen, so an old response could still update it.

summary: The main parcel intelligence view showing the mapped parcel, its identity, calculated area, area comparisons between sources, pairwise comparisons, and a method note.
purpose: Lets the owner compare the area of the parcel from different sources and see whether they agree.
why: Likely reason: the comparison shows where records and measurements differ, with a legal disclaimer. Reason partly stated in the policy text.
how: Loads the parcel intelligence data for the case. Shows a loading or empty state until then. Once loaded, displays a map, a safety note, the parcel identity fields, calculated areas, a card for each area source, a summary, an earth observation teaser, a list of pairwise comparisons, and a method section with the disclaimer.
inputs: A case ID, the parcel intelligence API response, and the current language.
outputs: A full parcel comparison page with map, tables, cards and links.
risks: A comparison that refers to a missing source would fail because the code assumes the source exists. Some labels are typed in Hindi and English. The area numbers depend on the API.
debug: If the panel stays on loading, check the parcel intelligence endpoint. If it shows the empty state, check the error and the response shape. If a comparison is missing, check the source type names in the response.
